batting.dismissal: c AB Dinda b B Kumar

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b NLTC Perera

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c CL White b A Mishra

batting.name: MN Samuels
batting.dismissal: c CL White b NLTC Perera

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: st PA Patel b A Mishra

batting.name: AM Nayar
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b A Mishra

batting.name: AB Dinda
batting.dismissal: c CL White b DW Steyn

balls.text: another good yorker, the batsman blocks it in front and calls for a quick single
full delivery on off stump, this time he drives it down to long-off
another full delivery, but this one comes with some room and the batsman creams it through extra cover for much-needed rehydration
another full and fast delivery on the stumps, blocked out towards midwicket
goes for a yorker, but it's a low full toss on off stump, the batsman punches it down the ground to long on
bowls a quicker and fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman drives it in the air down to long-on
another one in the block hole outside off, the batsman jams it down to third man for a single

caught at short fine leg! Smart catch by Dinda, who palms it over his head and takes it on the second go. It was a low full toss outside off and Vihari walks across to the off side to scoop it over the fielder, but doesn't get much elevation and Dinda takes a good catch
short of length delivery on the body, the batsman slaps it over backward square leg
slower delivery this time, wide outside off and the batsman gets foxed  by it, beaten again
a good yorker outside off and this one sneaks under the bat
pitched up delivery on the stumps, the batsman gets a thick outside edge down to third-man

dropped by Pandey, after taking a good catch off the previous ball, Pandey drops this one and it bursts through his palms to go to the boundary. The batsman timed the length ball really well, but this should have been taken

caught at long-on! The low full-toss does the job. It is quick outside off, the batsman this time gets a bat on this but ends up hitting it high without any timing, the ball descends for long-on to take a simple catch
bowls a low full-toss wide outside off, the batsman swings and misses. He is a bit disappointed to miss out on that one
he leaps and bowls a low full toss on the stumps, the batsman just pushes it to long on to bring Perera back on strike
fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman goes for an inside out shot, misses it completely
bowls a good yorker outside off, the batsman jams his bat down and steers it to point, but the ball goes through the fielder. Perera off strike, smart move by Mitch Marsh at point
bowls a low full-toss, it is driven down to long-off for a single
this time he goes for a drive to deep extra cover, Marsh runs around from long-off and makes a diving save
he is lighting it up, this one is a medium-pacer's length delivery on off, smoked over the long-on boundary, deep into the stands
goes for another hoick, but gets a leading edge over the bowler's head, the lack of pace helps him to come back for a couple
this time it is in his arc, he slogs it over midwicket and it goes flat to the cow-corner
quicker and fuller wide outside off, the batsman stays rooted to the crease and misses his drive
attempts another yorker, but it's a low full-toss outside off, the batsman ends up slicing it to point
another yorker, this time on leg stump, Perera brings his heavy bat down and blocks it to deep midwicket for a quick couple
bowls a leg cutter outside off, the batsman waits and opens the face to run it down to third man
stays in the crease and pushes the length delivery towards midwicket
bowls a good yorker on the middle stump, the batsman belatedly brings his bat down and jabs it towards square leg
skiddy length delivery angled across the left-hander, he goes for a front-foot pull but gets beaten
tries to work it to the leg side, but gets a leading edge to off instead
comes forward and plays the tossed up delivery with the turn to deep square leg, they call for a quick couple
quicker delivery, he tries to whack it hard but his hand comes off the handle, ends up pushing it to long-on
slows it down outside off, the batsman goes back and tucks it towards midwicket for a single

caught at deep midwicket! It was quicker and fuller on the stumps, in the batsman's arc and White goes for a big swing. It looked like he had got enough on it to take it into the stands, but then it only went as far as Mitch Marsh in the deep, who gobbles up a straightforward chance
flat, short and quick on the stumps, punched to midwicket
low full toss on the pads, the batsman pushes it to deep midwicket
shorter delivery on off stump, again he looks to flog it over midwicket and gets an inside edge towards square leg
tossed up, it was in Perera's zone and he goes for a massive swing, but gets an inside edge on to his pads
now he clubs it past the bowler, all along the ground and it was powerful indeed, the fielder at long-on had no chance
quicker and full outside off, the batsman drives it through extra cover, gets a lot of power behind that one and a pedestrian effort by Bhuvi at the boundary gives Perera a four
pushed through on the middle and leg line, the batsman pushes it down to long on
comes down the pitch to a quicker delivery, it nowhere near the line or the length, plays all over it as he charges down the pitch and loses his leg stump
quicker delivery on the pads, the batsman waits on the back foot and punches it to deep midwicket
pushed through on off and middle stump, the batsman defends it to the leg side
this time he goes on the back foot and again punches it to cover
much slower, the batsman has to wait after advancing down the pitch, can only push it to cover
slower delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it towards mid-on, but Yuvraj runs around to get to the ball
has a heave, mishits it down to deep backward square
banged it short as he saw the batsman coming out, tennis-foprehanded down to long off
presses forward and turns it down to long on
bit more of a forward push this time, and he opens the face to run it to point
bounce, lots of it, and no insignificant turn, White prods half forward and is nowhere close to it
hit down to long on
slower now, the speed gun seems to be on drugs, it is clocked at 95 kph ... and if that is 95 kph, I am Boom Boom Afridi, batsman stepped out initially, stopped, and then slapped it down to long off
nudged off the pad to vacant midwicket, Yuvraj after it, slides, misses the ball, deep midwicket runs in to pick it up
sharp turn for Yuvraj now, pitches good length on off and swerves and bounces, White, stuck pinned on the crease, is surprised and beaten
he's got something on it as he's gone down to paddle scoop it from middle, the ball's gone very fine, and has been hauled back just inside
steady on a length, turned through midwicket
sharp turn from a length outside off, White reaches out for it, and is beaten

big strike, he's beaten Sangakkara in the flight here, made him charge out, the tossed up delivery is not as full as Sangakkara thought, it's pitched good length, turned in past the bat and hit middle
flighted very full, hit down to long on
shuffles about in the crease, tries to cut, misses as it skids quickly outside off
tossed up on a good length, he gets forward to push to short extra cover
chips a full delivery in the air down to long on
bowls a yorker on off stump, the batsman jabs it towards midwicket and calls for quick single
fuller delivery on off, he drives it down the ground to long-off
now he finds the middle of his bat and hoicks it to deep midwicket, the ball just bounces and goes out of the reach of a diving Mitch Marsh..
another back of length delivery, this time on the stumps, Sanga drives it on the up to long-off for a single
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman tries to drive it down the ground but gets beaten
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman drives it firmly down the ground, to long-off
pushed through on the middle and leg line, the batsman punches it to long on for a single
he comes down the track and cuts the quicker delivery straight to point
this one is quicker on the stumps, the batsman waits on the back foot and whips it to deep midwicket
length delivery just outside off, the batsman pushes it to the fielder at short cover
short delivery outside off, the batsman is again a little late in his pull shot, ends up slapping it towards long-on without any timing
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman drives it to deep cover
length delivery on off, he just dabs it on the off side and calls for a quick single
another slower delivery, but this one is on pads and short enough for Sanga to just place it in the gap at deep backward square leg
takes two steps down the pitch and pushes the length delivery to point
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman tries to drive it without getting close to the line, he gets a thick outside edge to third-man
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman just dabs it towards gully for a quick single
bowls a slower length delivery outside off, the batsman drags it to long-on as this comes slow off the pitch
short delivery aimed at the throat, but Sanga plays it beautifully, swivels and finds the boundary at deep backward square leg with ease
tries to drive a wide delivery without really getting close to the ball. Gets beaten.
goes for a short delivery outside off, the ball doesn't bounce much though, goes to the keeper after a bounce
he tries to run it down to third-man, but ends up chopping it to the keeper

hello hello, Dinda bowls it full, the ball just swings enough, the batsman swings but it's a loose one as he doesn't move his feet, tries to launch it to the leg side, plays across the line and the off stump takes a beating
length delivery just outside leg stump, the batsman walks across to the off side and tries to flick it, misses and the ball is called a wide
short delivery, the batsman is a bit late in his pull shot, is able to hit it as far as short fine leg
this time he waits in the crease and opens the face to run down the pacy delivery down to the third-man boundary
takes a tiny step down the pitch and punches it to extra cover where Angelo makes a good stop, but can't prevent the single
flatter delivery on off, forces it to cover
and another quicker one outside off, Parthiv tries to punch it over the infield, but it goes behind him, thick edge to the third-man boundary
another flat delivery, this time it is punched to Yuvraj at mid-off, a misfield allows a single
bowls it flat and quick on the stumps, the batsman pulls it along the ground, but straight to midwicket
he misreads the length and tries to whip the short of length delivery, gets a leading edge towards off side
takes a couple of steps down the wicket and tries to whip the length delivery to the leg side, misses and gets hit on the pads, the ball rolls to the off side
tries to flash at a short of length delivery without any feet movement, he is beaten as the ball goes away with the angle
clears his front foot and tries to smash the length delivery towards long-on, he mistimes it completely and it just drops short of diving mid-on
keeps it just outside off, the batsman stays on the back foot and dabs it to point
bowls a beauty that beats the batsman outside off, it seams away from the batsman from short of a length  and Reddy gets squared up
he keeps it tight on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to Taylor at midwicket
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman taps it behind square on off side
length delivery on the pads, the batsman just chips it over midwicket, more of a leading edge as he tries to flick it
length delivery on off stump, the batsman gets inside the line and turns it on the leg side, to fine leg
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to the off side
bowls length outside off, the batsman plants his front foot forward and slashes it over the fielder at cover, flat and to the boundary
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman makes some room and punches it on the up through extra cover
back of length delivery on off, the batsman waits and dabs it to point, thinks about a single, but gets back in time
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and slices it to third man
now swing, short of length delivery on the stumps, defended to midwicket off front foot
bowls a fuller length on off stump, the batsman comes forward and opens the face to run it to point
bowls a quick bouncer outside off, the batsman hops on his toes and dabs it towards gully for a single
short and slightly wide outside off, the batsman slaps it straight to the fielder at cover point
tossed up outside off, the batsman drives it straight to cover
pushed through on off, it is driven down to long-on for a single
flatter delivery, turns into the batsman, defended off the back foot towards point
bowls a quicker one but this one turns down the leg side
bowls it slow on the stumps from round the wicket, tucked to square leg for a single
tossed up delivery, slow, on off stump, driven down to long-on

caught at first slip! Steyn takes three as a slash settles in the big palms of White at first slip. Steyn takes three off four deliveries, Angelo Mathews watches the ship sink at the other end, distraught..
length delivery beats the bat as the batsman hangs his bat .. misses the stumps, the batsman was actually getting away from the line of the ball
oh no! Was this a replay! No it wasn't. Bhuvi gave a sample of what not to do, but Rahul rehearses it again, this time he loses his leg stump..

the leg stump takes a beating! Steyn has been spewing fire but he wasn't able to do any damage. Now he joins in the fun. Bhuvi makes room by moving outside leg but this length ball is too quick for him, the leg stump is pulled out of the ground and Bhuvi goes back with head hung low in disappointment
bowls a quick full delivery outside off, the batsman punches it to long-off
dropped at long-on! low full-toss on off stump is smacked right down the ground and Vihari comes forward and dives forward, spills a tough chance
low full-toss outside off, the batsman stretches forward and punches it to deep cover
slower delivery on the stumps, the batsman goes straight down the ground to long-on
low full-toss outside off, slightly slower too, the batsman ends up pushing it towards long-on
he finds the boundary off a short of a length delivery, he goes for a front-arm jab and beats the man at long-on

oh my god! Angelo runs his partner out! It was a low full-toss on off and Angelo smacks it right back at the bowler who sticks his hand out and deflects the ball back onto the stumps, Marsh was miles outside the crease. Perera takes a blow to his hands but he has sent back another batsman from this never-ending batting line up
slower delivery outside off, but this is too short and Marsh lines himself up and goes with a golf swing over the bowler's head with a lot of power
another slower delivery on the pads, the batsman adjusts late and defends it to the leg side
length delivery outside off, the batsman goes inside out and chips it in the air towards deep cover, luckily for him, he doesn't time it too well
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to deep cover

he has been done in! The stumps are splayed! It was the back-of-the-hand slower ball on the stumps, Taylor goes across the line towards his favourite area around midwicket, is completely beaten by that one and hears the ugly clatter from behind..
bowls a good slower ball on the stumps, the batsman dabs it in the vast space on the leg side with soft hands, easy couple
flatter delivery on the pads, the batsman sweeps it hard to deep backward square leg for a single

caught at extra cover! It's Nayar's turn to go now. Beautiful loopy delivery outside off stump, the batsman comes down the pitch, but has to wait a little for the ball. He tries to cane it down the ground but gets a thick leading edge that lobs up for a gently catch at extra cover for Ishant Sharma..
quicker delivery on the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep midwicket for a couple
loopy delivery on the middle stump, full as well, the batsman is unable to get under it and whacks it to long-on where the fielder does well to keep the batsmen to a single
moves outside the leg stump and slaps the quicker delivery to deep cover
he goes leg side as he always does to a tossed up delivery, doesn't get hold of it, but ends up slapping it to deep midwicket
quick short delivery on the body, the batsman gets some bat on it as he tries to defend it, but the ball goes fine on the leg side
bowls a slower delivery on back of length, the batsman is through with his pull, the ball arrives much later
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman slaps it back to the bowler and it goes just over Steyn's head (he was a bit slow to react though), a single to long on
another length delivery just outside off, the batsman throws his bat, but hits it towards cover without any timing
length delivery on off stump, 146 kph (I don't trust this speed gun), the batsman pushes it to mid-on for a single
length delivery outside off, Nayar punches it down the ground, but Perera makes a diving save to keep the batsmen to a single
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it on the up, straight to Sanga at cover
slower delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it towards point and the two take a quick single
quick bouncer, goes past the helmet as the batsman goes for another pull
short delivery, 140 kph, the batsman somehow drags it to the leg side with an ungainly pull, the batsmen scamper back for a couple
length delivery on off stump, the batsman dabs it to cover for a quick single
length delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler
slower delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it to point and Nayar calls for a single, Taylor is late to respond and is struggling, but the bowler was unable to gather the throw cleanly..respite
length ball on off stump, the batsman plays another aerial shot, this time over midwicket and it goes to the fielder in the deep afte one bounce
short delivery, the batsman gets into a tangle as he walks across and tries to pull, he gets a top-edge that just beats the fielder at short fine-leg
length delivery on the pads and Nayar flicks it in the air to the deep backward square leg boundary for a one-bounce four
another back of length delivery wide outside off, the batsman crashes it off the back foot, but straight to deep cover
short of length delivery wide outside off, the batsman punches it to deep extra cover for a couple
beautiful googly, beats the batsman and beats the keeper (who didn't read it at all), runs to the boundary for some vital runs..
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and defends it to the leg side
pushed through on off stump, the batsman goes back and pushes it to midwicket for a single
tossed up delivery on the pads, the batsman works it to deep square leg to Steyn, who fires in a direct hit and the batsman take a single off the ricochet.

caught at point! Manish Pandey's misery is over as he goes after a conventional tossed up delivery on off stump, I am not sure what region he was targeting, but he gets a thick outside edge that lobs up high in the air for White to swallow a dolly
bowls a beautiful googly and the batsman had no idea about that, an inside edge saves him...
tossed up delivery wide outside off, the batsman stays in the crease and drives it to deep point
flatter and shorter outside off, Manish punches it straight to cover
flatter delivery on off stump, the batsman cuts it but can't beat the fielder at point
tossed up delivery on off, it spins past the bat as the batsman doesn't move his feet at all
flatter and shorter outside off, some turn too, the batsman goes on the back foot and pushes it to deep cover
pushed through on off stump, the batsman dabs it on the off side

flatter delivery on the pads, Taylor works it to deep square leg and they run a single. But Manish thinks about a single and leaves the crease, a quick flat throw comes from the deep and hits the stumps direct (Steyn there) and Manish Pandey has just slid his bat in...very close though

beautiful delivery by Mishra and Pune are digging a hole for themselves! Yuvraj started walking out of the crease and Mishra bowls a flat delivery on the pads, it grips the surface and turns down the leg side and Yuvi is left stranded as Parthiv takes the bails off in a jiffy.
flatter delivery, the batsman goes back and pushes it to long-on
tossed up delivery on the pads, Yuvraj goes for a trademark flick through midwicket, it goes flat to the fielder in the deep who does well to keep it in
pushed through outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends solidly
tossed up delivery on the stumps, some turn for Mishra too, the batsman defends it towards gully and steals a single
length delivery a bit wide outside off, the batsman takes a forward stride and pushes it to deep cover for a single
another back of length delivery on off, the batsman stays on the back foot and pushes it to the left of midwicket for a single
back of length delivery outside off, solidly defended back to the bowler

catching practice for first slip!  What was he thinking? He stays in the crease and just opens the face to give White a simple catch at first slip. He was aiming for the third man area, but this one skims of the surface of the bat and goes fine, White takes it easily in front of his face..
stays rooted in the crease and swings his bat at a wide length ball, gets beaten
length delivery outside off, the batsman tries to flash at that one from the crease, he gets a bottom edge past the lone slip and it runs down to the boundary
bowls it from wide of the crease, the batsman defends it towards point off the back foot and scampers through for a single
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the back foot
quicker delivery on off stump, the batsman goes on the back foot and is lucky to get an inside edge on that
more loop in that one, it dips into the batsman who defends it down the pitch
fuller tossed up delivery on off, Samuels pushes it back to the bowler
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
similar delivery and Samuels edges it to the keeper, but this one didn't bounce much and drops short of the keeper

action replay of the previous delivery and Robin this time succeeds to edge it to the keeper, simple chance, but it was the length that kept the batsman inside the crease. He tried to open the face while staying rooted in the crease and ended up giving a simple catch
good ball as this one beats the bat outside off, Robin tried to defend that without getting behind it
more runs now, he stays in the crease and opens the face to a wider length delivery to run it down to the third man boundary
advances makes room by moving outside leg stump and just times it inside out, just lands in inside the long-on boundary
tries to pull the short of length delivery, but it doesn't bounce as much as it is bowls a bit slower and goes under the bat
bowls a back-of-hand slower ball, but this one goes down the leg side
another length ball outside off, 142 kph, the batsman defends it to cover
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
back of length delivery on off stump, he goes back and dabs it towards gully for a quick single
he breaks the shackles with a lofted drive over long-off off a length ball, this one goes over the boundary easily, he just hit it with timing..
fuller length delivery, but this is down the leg side, called a wide
charges down the pitch, but Ishant is too pacy for this kind of shot, it bounces over the bat as Uthappa is beaten
length delivery on off stump, the batsman works it towards wide mid-on with a wristy shot
uppish drive, but it drops just short of the fielder at extra cover
length delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and turns it past midwicket for another couple
length delivery with some width, cut hard but straight to point
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman ramps it over the slip fielder but third man cuts it off
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman stands tall and defends it to the off side
starts off with a short delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and pulls it in front of square for a quick couple of runs
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and leans in to his drive, but pushes it straight to extra cover
length delivery on the off stump, the batsman turns it behind square on the leg side and calls for a couple
length delivery outside off, Uthappa tries to get going with a lofted drive, but doesn't get hold of it at all, it drops just over the fielder running backwards from cover point
fuller length delivery on the middle stump line, he doesn't come forward but wrists it through midwicket for a couple
oh this one cuts in to the batsman from a length, goes past the outside edge and it misses the off stump too
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman works it to deep square leg for a single
and another outswinger, 140 kph, beats the bat again as the batsman tries to run it down to third man
tries to push at that outswinger without any feet movement, it beats the bat
stays in the crease and guides the short of length delivery outside off to third man for a single
length delivery, another circumspect defensive poke by the batsman, plays it towards point
short of length delivery on off stump, 140 kph, defended off the back foot
pitches the length ball on middle stump, some shape there too, the batsman pushes it in the gap at wide mid-on
length ball on the pads, the batsman goes on the back foot and works it to deep square leg for a single
another length ball, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to extra cover
length delivery outside off, the batsman defends it to the off side off the back foot
oh I haven't seen this in a while, Ishant pitches it on a length outside off and takes it away, it didn't go straight, the batsman lets it go..
short of length delivery on off stump, the batsman hops on his toes and tucks it to square leg
short and wide outside off, the batsman tries to cut it without moving his feet, gets a bottom edge on its way to the keeper
and another one, it goes past the outside edge again, Uthappa hangs his bat at that one
beats the bat with an outswinger outside off, the batsman follows the line and it keeps going away from him
short delivery outside off, the batsman awkwardly dabs it towards mid-on and calls for a quick single
length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends it back to the bowler
good delivery, on  a length on off, it swings away and the batsman gets a thick edge to third man
bowls a fuller length delivery on the leg stump, some shape on it too, defended towards the leg side
